κακον has no accent in the print.

uncertain.note: There is a small mark under η that could be an iota subscript (γαλῇ) or a broken descender. I read it as γαλῆ.
The mark after στιχήρης looks like a full stop, not a comma.
The breathing on the initial ο is a small blob and could be smooth or rough. I kept rough.
The left edge of the strip is cropped, so the start of the line reads 'lom'. I read it as kännedom (d cut off).
The accent on the second ἑαυτὸν is faint; it could be acute or grave.
The broken mark after τέχνη could be a comma or a full stop.

uncertain.text: ὁ, ἡ, τὸ κατὰ τὴν ἐπιστήμην
uncertain.note: Only a dot shows above το, so the accent may be broken. I wrote τὸ.
The ε is partly broken but readable.
Only a colon is visible after ἡ, so a period may have dropped out.
A mark under α in θρᾳ reads as an iota subscript. There is none under κρύφα.
